summary: District-based Black Ops 3 Zombies map built around Beast Mode, rituals, the underground Rift, Gateworms, Pack-a-Punch unlock, the Apothicon Sword, Civil Protector, Rocket Shield, Apothicon Servant, Harvest Pods, and a large set of side easter eggs.

files.summary: Map overview, district structure, Beast Mode, rituals, Rift, and the main progression systems of Shadows of Evil.

Pack-a-Punch unlock, all four rituals, Summoning Key setup, ritual items including Nero's Fountain Pen, Jackie's Police Badge, Jessica's Hairpiece / Wig, Floyd's Championship Belt, Gateworms, and the final ritual in the Sacred Place.
How to access the sword room, read and match symbols, charge the egg at statues, obtain the Apothicon Sword, and upgrade it into the Reborn Keeper Sword.
Rocket Shield part locations in Canals, Waterfront, and Footlight, plus the Goddard Apparatus upgrade.
How to build the Apothicon Servant using Margwa Heart, Margwa Tentacle, and Xenomatter.
Fumigator spawns, Harvest Pod stages, and possible pod rewards including the purple pod drops.
Civil Protector fuse locations, Rift fuse box activation, and summon panel usage.
Workbench locations in Canals, Footlight, and Waterfront.
Main easter egg flow including Pack-a-Punch, sword setup, Nero's book, flag step, Shadow Man fight, and the 4-player final step.
How to get the free 500 points reward from Chang's Laundry.
How to shoot the Shadow Man at spawn to skip to rounds 5, 10, or 15.
How to upgrade Trip Mines into cream cakes using the Devo Donut carts.
How to upgrade Trip Mines into donuts using the Holly's Cream Cakes signs.
How to get a free random Mega Gobblegum using Widow's Wine, lion statues, and the candy shop plate.
How to upgrade Lil' Arnies after getting 100 kills and throwing them at the cane, hat, and bow tie.
How to unlock the Margwa Head by shooting the six tram heart targets and where the reward can spawn.
How to activate Noir Mode in the boxing gym and apply the black-and-white filter.
How to trigger the Ultimis Richtofen jumpscare after opening Pack-a-Punch.
Story easter egg showing the Icarus plane from Mob of the Dead flying over Junction.
How to play Snakeskin Boots by interacting with the three wooden radios.
How to build the microphone on the Burlesque stage and play Cold Hard Cash.
